I posted two messages in #strategic-pod explaining this. The first one said the time zone "still needs checking," which was accurate, and the second corrected the status. I should have checked the schedule before posting, so the channel got two notes where one would do.

Once the gateway is running and the schedule is correct, I'll confirm here. Until then, the job will not post anything.
